g.text: Cue-on response for 100 native units. Rate is measured from the native RHS at each saved state; no reintegration.
Native cue: full physical support 3, prescribed peak 1; matched input-coefficient integral 1.5, not activated amount.
Cue-on time axes: linear from 0–1, logarithmic thereafter. Rates are angular activity-vector rates; they are not peak travel or cell velocity.
Weak R < 0.1 would mask heading and rate independently; no weak interval occurs here. All selected histories pass the finite full-field tail check.
